# Sleep log, week of March 9

Keeping this for a few weeks to see whether the late-afternoon coffee is
actually the thing wrecking my sleep, or whether I just tell myself that.

## What I changed

Cut the second coffee after 2pm starting Monday. Kept everything else the same
as far as I can tell — same bedtime target, same room temperature, no travel.

## Night by night

Monday felt like the worst one. Took a long time to drop off even though I was
tired at the right hour, and I woke up twice. Tuesday was better and I did not
wake up at all that I remember.

By Wednesday I was falling asleep quickly and the watch agreed with how I felt,
which does not always happen. Thursday was ordinary.

## What I want to check

Whether the deep sleep number tracks how rested I actually feel, or whether it
is mostly noise week to week. Also whether the resting heart rate trend moves
with the sleep changes or independently of them. #followup
